title: Secure Client-Staff Messaging Module
description:
Implement a Secure Client-Staff Messaging Module in the Portal.
1. Create a `messages` table in the database to store messages between clients and staff. Fields: `id`, `senderId`, `recipientId`, `content`, `taxReturnId` (optional context), `isRead`, `createdAt`.
2. Implement a "Messages" tab in the Client Portal.
3. Allow clients to send questions or updates regarding their tax return.
4. Implement a staff view to see and respond to client messages.
5. Add email/SMS notifications for new messages (using the existing `src/lib/notifications.ts` logic).
6. Ensure all messages are encrypted at rest if they contain PII (use the project's existing encryption utility).
